Second row: "2026-02-27 | BIKANERVALA FOODS PRIVATE LIMITED | A.K. SALES CO. LTD., | FOOD PREPARATION NES ITEMS:-PAPAD KALI MIRCH 200G (E) 8 KG- ALBRATOS CFS PVT LTD ICD INAPL6, India | Bangkok, THAILAND | 19059040 | 1074515". Source counter: page claims 28,197 total shipments; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 shipment rows (all dated 2026-02-27), plus buyer/supplier/port summary tables (top buyers: NOBLE IMPORTS LLC 1319, AMBROSIA PARADE RESTAURANTS LLC 1336, INDYA FOODS PTY LTD 1504, BIKANERVALA FOOD INDUSTRIES LLC 1007, AMBROSIA PARADE 1390; top ports: ALBRATOS CFS ICD 2094, INAPL6 1954, Auckland 307, PORT HAMAD 270, Nepalganj 239). Only 5 of 28,197 rows verified directly.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic/international split found in public sources within the tool budget. The company website (bikanervala.com) lists retail delivery across India ("Free Delivery on ₹1000 Across India") and a restaurant network (Delhi, Gurugram, Chennai, Nepal, UAE, USA, UK, Singapore, Qatar, Canada, Bahrain, Australia) — this is a product catalogue / marketing claim, which per Rule 5 does not count as shipment fact. Domestic supply therefore: declared, not confirmed. Revenue: null (not public in sources checked).
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L numbers, destination and HS codes: 2026-02-27 to Baltimore USA (HS 19054000, B/L 1076350), 2026-02-27 to Bangkok Thailand (HS 19054000, B/L 1074515; HS 19059040, B/L 1074515), 2026-02-27 to Baltimore USA (HS 19053100, B/L 1076350). Declared HS set (040310;190540;190590;210690) is consistent with observed 1905-series codes; no HS correction needed. Caveat on evidence depth: the aggregator advertises 28,197 records but only 5 rows were visible on the free view — the remaining volume is unverified, and no independent second source (volza/eximpedia/importgenius/trademo) could be opened because web_search returned connection errors and Google/Bing returned 429 or irrelevant results. Domestic (India) supply side is NOT confirmed: no GST turnover figure, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract, no annual-report split was retrievable; revenue and export value = null, not estimated. Note the entity is part of the Bikanervala/Bikano group and the customs records show related-party buyers (BIKANERVALA FOOD INDUSTRIES LLC Dubai, AMBROSIA PARADE RESTAURANTS LLC USA), i.e. group distribution channels rather than purely third-party trade. No rejection grounds: legal entity exists and is active in customs data.
